details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7568-7595 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The standalone `run_standalone_stall_recovery` `retrigger_review` path still performs the empty-commit push without the in-flight guard, remote-head recheck, or `_rtr_push_succeeded` tracking.
  WHY: If `issue_has_active_workflow` misses a concurrent `review_autofix` run, the branch tip can still advance and invalidate in-flight editor work, reproducing the stale-base loop this PR is meant to prevent.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5749-5805 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The in-flight guard reads a cached actions-runs snapshot before the empty-commit push, leaving a TOCTOU window where a new `review_autofix` run can be missed.
  WHY: A run that starts after the cache load but before the push will not be in the snapshot and can still be invalidated even though the later fetch/recheck path runs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5751-5762 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Non-numeric `date +%s` output or jq/cache parse failures force `_rtr_inflight_id` to empty and skip the in-flight guard.
  WHY: The fail-open branch disables the protection for that tick, allowing recovery to proceed against an active review when the timestamp or cached blob is unavailable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5777-5781 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5]
  PROBLEM: The early return when the PR head has advanced returns 1 without setting `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: Logs and telemetry can still show the prologue value `retrigger_review`, so a skipped retrigger looks like it succeeded from observability alone.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5790-5802 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The remote-head recheck / push-success failure paths return 1 without updating `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: The effective-action field remains `retrigger_review` on skipped or failed retrigger paths, which is misleading for logs and telemetry even though control flow uses the return code.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5810-5813 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The later push-success guard returns 1 without setting `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: Operators can see the stale `retrigger_review` value even when no push actually occurred.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5766 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` value is not recognized by existing consumers.
  WHY: Future exhaustive matching or dashboards can silently miss the skipped-inflight case, reducing observability for exactly the path this PR added.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5789 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The new value `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` introduces a contract string not enumerated in existing consumers.
  WHY: No current consumer matches this value, so the case is only visible in logs and would be easy to miss in future exhaustive matching.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5763 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: `_rtr_head_sha` is used in the jq filter but is not defined within the `retrigger_review` action block itself.
  WHY: The reviewer reports it is only established earlier in function setup, so the block depends on state outside the case body.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1558-1584 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `--jq` mock calls `save()` before the nested jq subprocess, so a jq failure leaves the test store partially updated.
  WHY: Later calls in the same test session can observe stale ETag/status counts, making the mock nondeterministic.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7569-7576 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone `retrigger_review` path pushes an empty commit without any of the new managed-path defenses.
  WHY: It lacks the in-flight Actions run guard, the remote-head recheck, and push-success tracking, so a missed concurrent `review_autofix` run can still be invalidated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5794-5797 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The remote-head recheck return-1 path leaves `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` at the stale `retrigger_review` value.
  WHY: Logs and telemetry can report `retrigger_review` even though the action was skipped.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5810-5813 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The push-success guard returns 1 without setting `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: The effective-action field remains stale even when no push occurred.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5751-5805 | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A TOCTOU window exists between the cached Actions-runs snapshot and the actual git push.
  WHY: A `review_autofix` run that starts after the cache load but before the push will not be detected and can still be invalidated.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5789 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The new `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` value introduces a contract string not enumerated in existing consumers.
  WHY: The PR describes this as visibility-only, so the new value is not handled by any current consumer.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5799-5802 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The final push-success check returns 1 without setting `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: This leaves telemetry incomplete when checkout or push fails.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5777-5781 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The early return when the PR head has advanced also returns 1 without setting `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION`.
  WHY: This path skips setting the action before returning, so the telemetry gap is the same as the push-failure path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5749-5760 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The in-flight guard uses a cached actions-runs snapshot without rechecking after the fetch, leaving a TOCTOU window before the empty-commit push.
  WHY: A `review_autofix` run that starts after cache load but before the push can still be missed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5759 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: If `date +%s` returns non-numeric output, the guard silently skips the inflight check by setting `_rtr_inflight_id=""`.
  WHY: Fail-open behavior can allow recovery to proceed against an active review run when the timestamp is unavailable.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5766 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The new `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION="retrigger_review_skipped_inflight"` value introduces a new contract string that no downstream consumer currently handles.
  WHY: Future exhaustive matching on the action field can silently miss this value, making the case visible only in logs.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5763 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `_rtr_head_sha` is used in the jq filter but is never defined within the `retrigger_review` action block itself.
  WHY: It is defined earlier in the function setup, so the block depends on external state rather than establishing the value locally.
=== END FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
(No findings reported.)
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~7568-7595 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone stall-recovery `retrigger_review` case still contains the old unconditional empty-commit push and does not invoke the new guard logic.
  WHY: When `issue_has_active_workflow` misses a concurrent run, standalone issues can still trigger the stale-base loop the PR is trying to close.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5759-5762 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `date +%s` produces non-numeric output or the command fails, `_rtr_inflight_id` is forced empty and the in-flight guard is skipped.
  WHY: A live `review_autofix` run on the same `head_ref` can be invalidated by the orchestrator's push under this fail-open path.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5774-5782 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The post-fetch `_rtr_origin_head_sha` recheck still leaves a TOCTOU window because the earlier in-flight guard uses a cached snapshot that is never refreshed.
  WHY: A `review_autofix` job can start after `_load_actions_runs_cached` but before the fetch/push, and the stale-base gate will still fire.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5790-5798 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Early returns on fetch/checkout failure or non-successful push set neither `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` nor the recovery counter.
  WHY: Telemetry and stall-recovery-count logic become inconsistent, so a failed retrigger can be counted or logged as if it completed recovery work.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~7568-7572 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The standalone `run_standalone_stall_recovery` path for `retrigger_review` still contains the old empty-commit logic and does not apply the new guard logic.
  WHY: If `issue_has_active_workflow` misses a concurrent run, standalone issues can still trigger the exact stale-base loop the PR was written to close.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5760-5751 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The jq filter can yield an empty string on parse error, missing key, or non-200 cached blob, and the script treats that as "no in-flight run".
  WHY: Transient cache corruption or API-shape changes silently disable the guard for that tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5766 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A new magic string is emitted that no consumer currently recognizes.
  WHY: Future exhaustive matching or grep-based dashboards can silently drop observability for the skipped-inflight case.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1558-1584 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The new `--jq` mock calls `save()` before the nested jq subprocess, so a jq failure leaves the test store partially updated.
  WHY: Later calls in the same test session can observe stale ETag/status counts, breaking determinism and the mock's HTTP-round-trip contract.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
